subject: Re: MAP — evaluation closure criteria, exit checks and smoke exercises
messages:
From: Dr. Lina Morales <lina.morales@mednova.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: MedNova Procurement <procure@mednova.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation acceptance and go/no-go checks

Hi Aditya (and team),

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We have a tight window to validate the integration and nominate acceptance for our pilot by the end of the month. Procurement asked that we put the acceptance criteria into the MAP so they can align contract milestones and the payments schedule.

To be actionable, we need from Redwood:
- A concise checklist of pass/fail acceptance tests (functional + perf) we can run on our test dataset.
- Clear exit gates (what constitutes failure vs. required remediation).
- Expected evidence artifacts (logs, audit trail, sample outputs).
- Timeline to run the smoke tests and a responsible owner.

I attached a one-page PoV expectations doc and procurement asked to see the MAP + SOW redlines before legal engages. Can you send the MAP draft with those items and a brief runbook for the smoke exercises?

Ideal target: I want the MAP and smoke-test plan by EOD Monday so our engineering team can schedule the validation during the week.

Best,
Lina
Chief Data Officer | MedNova Health

Attachment: MedNova_PoV_expectations.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation acceptance and go/no-go checks

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the PoV doc. Looping in Marissa (CS) and Karthik (Solutions) to finalize the MAP and the smoke-test pack.

Quick plan:
1) We’ll provide a MAP draft that includes: success criteria (functional pass thresholds), exit gates, evidence list, and an itemized acceptance-test catalog.
2) A two-day smoke exercise runbook that your engineers can run on a staging token with our dev cluster.
3) A short statement of fallback behavior and remediation SLAs if a gate fails.

Deliverables and owners:
- MAP draft + acceptance checklist (attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx) — Aditya (owner) — target: Mon EOD PT.
- Smoke-test cases (attachment: smoke-test-cases.md) — Karthik (owner) — target: Tue morning PT so MedNova can run Wed/Thu.
- SOW redline summary for procurement (attachment: SOW_redlines.pdf) — Marissa (owner) — target: Mon EOD PT.

Two clarifying Qs so we make the acceptance tests executable:
1) Which dataset snapshot will you use for the smoke run? (name + size + redaction status)
2) Minimum throughput expectation (p95 latency) you need to validate under pilot load?

If we get those answers today, we can lock the MAP and smoke runbook Monday and share a single-URL bundle.

Thanks — sending the initial MAP draft now for internal review, will attach to the shared Drive when ready.

— Aditya
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP draft — acceptance states, exit gates, and evidence

Team — summary of what I added to MAP_v3.xlsx: 
- Success criteria (three buckets): Functional correctness (precision/recall thresholds per intent), Safety/guardrail compliance (no policy violations in 10k sample), Operational SLOs (p95 latency < 350ms at pilot concurrency).
- Exit gates: 
  * Gate A (Fail-critical): System returns toxic or PHI-exposing content in any sampled session — immediate pause + remediation.
  * Gate B (Remediation required): >5% of responses show hallucination beyond defined tolerance — pause + hotfix sprint.
  * Gate C (Acceptable with caveats): Minor formatting or template mismatches — track and address during pilot.
- Evidence artifacts required per test: raw model outputs (sample set), inference logs (token-level), latency traces, replay harness inputs.
- Acceptance-test examples included (see smoke-test-cases.md) with pass/fail criteria and commands to run.

Procurement ask: I added a one-paragraph clause that links go-live to the mutual acceptance sign-off (two internal approvers: MedNova CDO + Redwood CS Director). That should keep SOW redlines minimal.

Next steps before sending to Lina: 
- Karthik: confirm the commands and expected exit-codes in smoke-test-cases.md (I flagged two questionable commands).
- Aditya: confirm the remediation SLA wording (I propose 48 hours for high-severity fixes during pilot).

Once we agree, I’ll attach the three stubs and send to Lina and procurement with a short timeline: run smoke tests Wed/Thu, decision call Fri local.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: MAP_v3.xlsx, smoke-test-cases.md, SOW_redlines.pdf
